title: Settlement engine contract compatibility tests for LLM-sourced appraisal output
objective: Write a dedicated test module that feeds synthetic LLM-shaped AppraisalOutput values (no real LLM calls) into the settlement engines and asserts that outputs are numerically correct and within expected bounds, confirming full end-to-end contract compatibility between the LLM appraisal path and the engine settlement layer.
exact_scope: One new test file covering: (1) mood and stress changes produced by settle_appraisal_output when given LLM-shaped AppraisalOutput instances across all absorption/valence/arousal combinations of interest; (2) growth buffer accumulation via accumulate_growth_from_appraisal for multi-contribution LLM outputs with varying guidance_resonance values; (3) relationship trust, closeness, and riskScore changes via apply_appraisal_to_relationship for LLM-shaped relational blocks; (4) residual creation from create_residual_from_appraisal for LLM outputs with aftershock_days > 0; (5) advisory fields (narrative_summary, confidence, tick_type, fallback_used) confirmed to have zero effect on any settlement arithmetic; (6) the full settle_appraisal_output entry point exercised with LLM-realistic synthetic outputs for T1, T2, and T4 tick types; (7) boundary checks confirming all settlement outputs stay within their declared bounds (mood 0–100, stress 0–100, trust 0–100, closeness 0–100, riskScore 0–100, aftershock_days 0–3). No modifications to any existing engine, model, or existing test file.
constraints: All test inputs must be synthetic (hand-crafted) AppraisalOutput objects — no actual LLM calls, no mocked LLM infrastructure
AppraisalSignal v1 fields are frozen — tests must not attempt to add or remove fields from AppraisalSignal or AppraisalOutput
Tests must not modify any engine file (appraisal_settlement.py, growth_synthesizer.py, relationship_synthesizer.py, relationship_drift.py)
Tests must not modify any existing test file
T3, T5, T6, T7, T8 deferred ticks remain out of scope — do not write settlement tests for those tick types
Settlement engines are the sole authority for numeric writes — tests must assert engine outputs, not construct ledger values directly
Do not use real LLM infrastructure, shadow_runner, or appraisal_router in these tests — purely direct engine invocation with crafted inputs
acceptance_criteria: A new test file test_p31_t5_settlement_contract.py exists under back/tests/
All tests in the new file pass with python -m pytest back/tests/test_p31_t5_settlement_contract.py -v
All existing tests continue to pass after the new file is added
Tests cover settle_appraisal_output for at least one LLM-realistic T1 output, one T2 output with a relational block, and one T4 output with a relational block
Tests assert that mood/stress deltas match the values in the _MOOD_STRESS_TABLE lookup for the given (valence, arousal, absorption) triple
Tests assert that growth buffer accumulation reflects the correct weight and guidance_resonance multiplier for partial and deep absorption levels
Tests assert that relationship trust, closeness, and riskScore are updated correctly and remain in [0, 100]
Tests assert that residuals are created with the correct days_remaining, stress_per_day, and mood_per_day for LLM outputs with aftershock_days > 0
Tests confirm that supplying non-None narrative_summary, confidence, fallback_used=False, or tick_type does not alter any numeric settlement output
Tests confirm that absorption=none produces no state change, no growth accumulation, no residual, and no relationship change regardless of other field values
Tests confirm that all settlement outputs for extreme but valid input values (mood at 95, stress at 95, max absorption + high arousal + negative valence) stay within [0, 100]
required_tests: Given a T1-shaped AppraisalOutput with absorption=partial, valence=positive, arousal=medium, guidance_resonance=aligned, and two growth contributions, when settle_appraisal_output is called, mood increases by 4 and stress decreases by 1 (matching the lookup table), and the growth buffer reflects contributions multiplied by 0.6 * 1.3

Given a T2-shaped AppraisalOutput with a relational block (trust_shift=mild_increase, closeness_delta=+1, risk_delta=-3) and absorption=surface, when settle_appraisal_output is called, the target relationship's trust increases by 2 and closeness increases by 1 (subject to inertia) and riskScore decreases by 3

Given a T4-shaped AppraisalOutput with a relational block (trust_shift=strong_decrease, closeness_delta=-2, risk_delta=+5) and absorption=deep, when settle_appraisal_output is called, the strong_decrease inertia bypass applies and trust decreases by 5

Given a LLM-shaped AppraisalOutput with aftershock_days=2 and absorption=partial and valence=negative, when create_residual_from_appraisal is called, a ResidualEntry is returned with days_remaining=2, stress_per_day=+2, mood_per_day=-2

Given the same LLM-shaped AppraisalOutput but with narrative_summary set to a long string and confidence=0.85, when settle_appraisal_output is called, the numeric outputs are identical to the case where those advisory fields are None

Given a LLM-shaped AppraisalOutput with absorption=none (deferred fallback shape), when settle_appraisal_output is called, the returned state is unchanged, the growth buffer is unchanged, no residual is returned, and any relational block present is ignored

Given a LLM-shaped AppraisalOutput with absorption=deep, valence=negative, arousal=high applied to an agent with moodScore=5 and stress=95, when settle_appraisal_output is called, moodScore does not drop below 0 and stress does not exceed 100

Given a LLM-shaped AppraisalOutput with three growth contributions (maximum allowed) and guidance_resonance=resisted, when accumulate_growth_from_appraisal is called, all three dimensions accumulate at 50% of their raw weight
Given a LLM-shaped T1 AppraisalOutput with aftershock_days=0, when create_residual_from_appraisal is called, None is returned regardless of absorption level
Given a LLM-shaped T2 AppraisalOutput where the relational target_id does not match any known relationship, validate_appraisal_signal raises a ValueError identifying the unknown target
non_goals: Do not call the real LLM, shadow_runner, or appraisal_router in any test
Do not test T3, T5, T6, T7, or T8 tick paths in this module
Do not test the audit logging layer (covered by test_p31_t4_appraisal_audit_log.py)
Do not test the validation gate or acceptance_rules logic (covered by test_p31_t2_validation_gate.py)
Do not modify any settlement engine, model, or previously existing test file
Do not add any new production code — this task produces only a test file
Do not add end-to-end simulate_day_bridged integration tests — those belong to the router integration layer already covered by test_p31_t3_router_integration.py
